name: Gakuen de Jikan yo Tomare
source:
“Seeing you so happy... makes me wanna screw you so bad.”

Gazing at the students of a prestigious girls’ school, a man smiles insincerely.
The ladies who attend this fine institute are the daughters of some of the most powerful political and economic figures of the country.
But all that this man harbors is resentment and twisted desires towards this esteemed establishment.

Then, one day, a mysterious figure hands the man a strange-looking weapon and claims it to be a time-freezing gun. Although he doesn’t trust this mysterious figure for a second, the man decides to sneak into the girls’ school and test the powers of this weapon for himself.
